name: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
rule: The copied data may be uninitialized or otherwise violate the validity requirements of `T`; `copy_nonoverlapping` does not require the data to be valid values of `T`.
api: const unsafe fn copy_nonoverlapping < T > (src : * const T , dst : * mut T , count : usize)
